comment: Renders of the original Downspout Octet (plugins/octet/src/octet_core.cpp and octet_spectrum.cpp, compiled natively) at 48 kHz in blocks of 128, 256 blocks, one sample in 64 of each channel, and the 64 spectrum levels after blocks 60, 120 and 255. The input is made from integers only so the module and the original see the same samples: next() is an LCG, s = s * 1664525 + 1013904223 mod 2^32 from 12345 returning s / 2^32, and per sample L = (next() * 2 - 1) * 0.3 + ((n * 29) % 500) / 500 * 0.4 - 0.2, R the same with next() for the right channel, 41 and 700. A command is ["p", block, index, value] (a parameter set before that block) or ["cc", block, channel, controller, value] (a MIDI controller before it).
